title: Chargers vs. Ravens: Listen Live to Monday Night Football on SiriusXM
summary: Los Angeles and Baltimore face off during NFL Week 10 at M&T Bank Stadium airing live on SiriusXM.
body_markdown:
The[Los Angeles Chargers](https://www.siriusxm.com/sports/nfl/los-angeles-chargers) and[Baltimore Ravens](https://www.siriusxm.com/sports/nfl/baltimore-ravens) face off on[Monday Night Football](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/monday-night-football-schedule-listen) closing out Week 10 of the 2026 NFL season in Charm City — and you can listen to every snap live on SiriusXM on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFLWk10ChargersRavens) .


[Chargers vs. Ravens Monday • 8:15PM ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFLWk10ChargersRavens)


### How to Listen to Chargers vs. Ravens


**Date:** Monday, November 16
**Time:** 8:15pm ET
**Location:** M&T Bank Stadium, Baltimore, Maryland
**Chargers broadcast:** Ch. 193 (car), Ch. 817 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFLWk10ChargersRavens) )
**Ravens broadcast:** Ch. 192 (car), Ch. 802 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFLWk10ChargersRavens) )
**National broadcast:**[SiriusXM NFL Radio (Ch. 88)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/siriusxm-nfl-radio) – car and ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFLWk10ChargersRavens) )
**Spanish-language broadcast:** Ch. 194 (car), Ch. 832 ([app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogNFLWk10ChargersRavens) )


### Every NFL Game Airs Live on SiriusXM


Every NFL game, from the regular season through the Super Bowl, is available to SiriusXM listeners both in their vehicles and via the SiriusXM app. Through the SiriusXM app, subscribers can tune in to both home and visiting team broadcasts for every matchup. Additionally, subscribers with sports play-by-play can access both home and road team broadcasts directly on their in-vehicle radios. The schedule of games airing on SiriusXM is available here:[SiriusXM.com/Sports](http://www.siriusxm.com/sports) .


Listeners can access NFL game broadcasts and the SiriusXM NFL Radio channel with SiriusXM’s most popular subscription plans, including Platinum, All Access and Music & Entertainment, as well as SiriusXM’s sports-focused subscription plan,[SiriusXM Sports Pass](http://www.siriusxm.com/siriusxmsportspass) , priced at $5 per month.
